text:
deploy-bot: rollout v2.14.3 to infra-edge canary (5%) completed by rollout-controller

erin: noticed spike in 503s from edge-canary around 1745678930, +8% error rate
amir: looking at metrics - increased RSS on edge pods, OOM kills starting at 1745678925
maggie: paging oncall (pd) now :rotating_light:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered -> oncall-sre (high priority)
oncall-sre: oncall-sre here, pulling logs and heap profiles, grabbing pod list
erin: sample logs show repeated allocation spikes during batched prefetch: `prefetch_batch`
amir: suspect regression from commit `abc1234` which changed prefetch buffer sizing in v2.14.3
product-oncall: customer impact: some streaming responses dropped for users routed to EU-edge canary (~0.3% of traffic) — tracking customers with high-volume sessions
oncall-sre: flipping feature flag `edge-prefetch.enabled` to `off` for canary to throttle prefetching (kill-switch)
maggie: flipping now via FF dashboard -> targeting infra-edge/canary :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: feature flag change recorded (audit id ff-1745678958)
oncall-sre: after kill-switch, OOMs stopped within ~90s, 503s trending back to baseline at 1745679000
amir: recommend immediate single-commit revert of `abc1234` on canary and prepare a small patch removing the aggressive buffer change
erin: +1 to revert on canary, then propagate once stable. I'll stage the revert PR and run unit/integration in runway env
amir: revert PR created: `revert-abc1234` -> CI green, ready to cherry-pick to canary
maggie: coordinating the quick patch release. Rolling revert to canary now (single commit revert).
deploy-bot: deploy started for canary: revert-abc1234 -> infra-edge (canary 5%)
oncall-sre: monitoring heap + error rates during revert rollout
erin: after revert rollout completes, confirm we can bump canary to 25% slowly, will hold before broad release
amir: preparing post-incident hotfix changelog and root-cause notes; hypothesis: buffer sizing + certain request patterns exhausted arena pools under high-parallel prefetch
product-oncall: customers impacted notified via status page: small number of streaming interruptions, no data loss. following up with targeted outreach for top 5 accounts.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-1745678901 - "Canary heap pressure after v2.14.3 prefetch change"
incident-bot: oncall handoff scheduled -> cynthia takes follow-up monitoring starting 1745679000 UTC
cynthia: taking handoff, will watch for regression for next 1h, will open follow-up ticket for perf test coverage and QA gate
oncall-sre: tagging this thread for postmortem; immediate mitigation successful, moving to monitoring and RCA tasks :white_check_mark:
maggie: good job team — short hotfix, minimal customer impact.
product-oncall: agree. we'll include rollback decision and FF kill-switch in postmortem playbook
incident-bot: incident status -> mitigated (status changed)
